english.title: Fly aircraft with national certificate of airworthiness otherwise than in accordance with article 51
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), which had a national certificate of airworthiness and was flown when the

(C)_[continuing airworthiness of the aircraft or a component fitted to the aircraft did not meet the requirements of Part 4 of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(D)_[aircraft did not remain in conformity with the type design approved by the CAA]_
(E)_[aircraft had been operated beyond the limitations of the approved flight manual or the airworthiness certificate, without subsequent appropriate action to restore airworthiness having been taken]_
(F)_[aircraft had been involved in an accident or incident that affected the airworthiness of the aircraft, without subsequent appropriate action to restore airworthiness having been taken]_
(G)_[aircraft had a modification or repair for which a certificate or release to service had not been issued in accordance with the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 51 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
